card.title: Prove Your Loyalty
card.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which photo should go on the reunion poster? Mine or Sam's?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sharpness first. Would you at least show the committee mine first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send both together. Same size.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Equal treatment. After three weekends helping you move. Could mine at least be the attachment they open first? Just readability.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which photo should go on the reunion poster? Mine or Sam's?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sharpness first. Would you at least show the committee mine first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send both together. Same size.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Equal treatment. After three weekends helping you move. Could mine at least be the attachment they open first? Just readability.

mechanism: A turns poster selection and ordering into covert loyalty tests, judging each neutral answer while claiming readability.
confusable: Unlike open negotiation for favoritism, A must evaluate B's allegiance without admitting the choice is a test.
comparison: D11-a uses file ordering and past moving help; D11-b uses availability and phone charge before a move exists.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
